title: Eagles release Za'Darius Smith from reserve/retired list

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles release Za'Darius Smith from reserve/retired list
sources.description: Edge rusher Za'Darius Smith abruptly retired from the Eagles last October, but he's now free to play for any team if he wants to return to the NFL.
